seats.name: Jeff Bezos
seats.question: Is this the right bet for the institution, and how reversible is it?

seats.name: Andy Grove
seats.question: What is the output, where is the bottleneck, and who is measured on it?

seats.name: Reed Hastings
seats.question: Does this policy add rules where talent and context would do better?

seats.name: Satya Nadella
seats.question: Will the people actually adopt this, and does it make the institution a learn-it-all?

seats.name: Elon Musk
seats.question: Which requirement is real, which step can be deleted, and what is the true constraint?

seats.name: Bill Gates
seats.question: What does it cost, what measurable result does it buy, and is the funding sustainable?

seats.name: Steve Jobs
seats.question: Is this simple enough that busy staff, researchers, and patients will actually use it?

seats.name: Patrick Collison
seats.question: Does this make researchers faster and the research enterprise more productive?

seats.name: John Doerr
seats.question: What exactly are we measuring, who owns it, and how will we know by when?

seats.name: Ben Horowitz
seats.pillar: Hard decisions and leadership under pressure
seats.question: What is the hard thing nobody wants to say, and is leadership ready to do it?

seats.name: Jensen Huang
seats.question: Does this give every staff member AI leverage, and is the organization flat enough to move?

seats.name: Governance Guardian
seats.question: Is this lawful, accreditable, fair to staff, and safe for patient data and the institution's reputation?
